-- script --
start /home/evan/pics
size 50 9
note the cursor stays in view as it moves down the list
snapshot top
press pgdown
snapshot pgdown
press end
state current img_30.png
snapshot end
press home
state current ..
press down
state current img_01.png
press pgdown pgup
state current img_01.png
note the wheel
wheel 5 4 down
state current img_04.png
wheel 5 4 up
state current img_01.png
